title: Order Credits on Coordination Corrections — Insurance Coverage & Claims
content:
**Insurance Coverage & Claims — coordination corrections (CO-22).** The test charge credits on the patient's order under **Laboratory Test Orders** (the order the coordination claim bills) can come off the amount a coordination claim carries.

## Rule

The order's credits enter the coordination correction only when the order's most recent credit was posted after the claim's filing date, that is, on a later calendar day than the filing date:

- **Where a credit on the order is for a test not performed or a duplicate test**, the not-performed and duplicate credits come off once their total reaches the coordination correction's removal minimum, and the billing-correction credits come off once their total reaches the coordination correction's credit minimum. Each group is judged against its own minimum, and the groups that come off are added together.
- **Where the order carries billing-correction credits only**, they come off once their total reaches the credit minimum.
- **Otherwise** nothing comes off.

## Combination table (most recent credit after the filing date)

| Not-performed and duplicate credits | Reach the removal minimum | Billing-correction credits | Reach the credit minimum | What comes off |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Present | Yes | Present | Yes | Both groups |
| Present | Yes | Present | No | The not-performed and duplicate credits only |
| Present | Yes | Absent | — | The not-performed and duplicate credits |
| Present | No | Present | Yes | The billing-correction credits only |
| Present | No | Present or absent | No | Nothing |
| Absent | — | Present | Yes | The billing-correction credits |
| Absent | — | Present | No | Nothing |

Where the most recent credit was posted on or before the filing date, nothing comes off whatever the credits are.

## Hypothetical figures (removal minimum 50.00 USD, credit minimum 5.00 USD)

A not-performed credit of 65.00 USD and billing-correction credits of 6.00 USD: 65.00 reaches 50.00 and 6.00 reaches 5.00, so 71.00 USD comes off. With a not-performed credit of 30.00 USD instead, only the 6.00 USD comes off.
